change.summary: Curated key layout and available resource-pack order are applied through one versioned native preference migration, without distributing options.txt.

modifiers.before: Native defaults and user key_ rows; no JEM preset consumer.
modifiers.after: Only real registered actions are applied from source-owned curated key map; no non-key profile settings. Existing profiles require /jemkeys preview/apply. Separate local receipt prevents update resets.
Apply newly added default bindings on the next managed-client generation only where the player has not customized that binding; retire TrashSlot and old backpack bindings.

modifiers.before: The embedded preset had later curated deviations from the checked-in original-controls snapshot.
modifiers.after: The embedded preset is mechanically rebuilt from Docs/releases/2026-10-26-original-controls-development-inventory/original-keybinds.txt. Only Backpacked and TrashSlot actions are omitted because those mods are no longer installed.

modifiers.before: Existing profiles with an older receipt would not automatically consume a replaced embedded preset.
modifiers.after: Every client profile applies the GitHub-derived preset once when its versioned 2026-10-28 receipt is absent. The receipt lives inside that profile, so test jem cannot consume the future JustEnoughMods/friend migration, and later launches or AutoModpack generations preserve player edits.

modifiers.before: The October receipt prevented the corrected key preset from running again, and no runtime owner applied the canonical resource-pack order because AutoModpack intentionally excludes options.txt.
modifiers.after: A new Major Update 4 receipt applies registered keys once, restores Hotbar 1-9, assigns FTB Quests to Numpad 7, and places the canonical pack order into native options before the initial PackRepository reload. The 2026-11-17 revision includes JEM Release v0.3. The first client tick saves without starting a second reload, and later player edits remain untouched.

rationale.purpose: Preserve the user key map while keeping primary race/map actions accessible.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-20 shipping/economy full handoff tasks8/13 and explicit compass investigation; concrete adapter choices by Codex.

introduced.summary: Key-only user layout with M/V/B/F6 and native modifier conflict resolution; clean-first-use or explicit one-time preview/apply.

history.summary: Key-only user layout with M/V/B/F6 and native modifier conflict resolution; clean-first-use or explicit one-time preview/apply.
Apply newly added default bindings on the next managed-client generation only where the player has not customized that binding; retire TrashSlot and old backpack bindings.
Rebuild the delivered key preset from the checked-in GitHub controls snapshot while removing only Backpacked and TrashSlot rows.
Apply the GitHub-derived keymap once per game directory with a new versioned receipt, then preserve all later player edits across reconnects, launcher restarts and future pack updates.
Issue a new one-time native migration for the corrected registered key map and canonical available resource-pack order without transferring options.txt.
Issue a fresh one-time preference receipt and include JEM Release v0.3 in the canonical native resource-pack selection.
Prepare the one-time native resource-pack order during Options.load so Minecraft uses it for the initial reload, then save keys and the filtered selection without a second runtime reload.

notes: Exact installed-source inspection and same-task Atlas lookup/scan precede implementation.
unresolved: Fresh startup acceptance remains pending after moving the one-time resource-pack order before Minecraft's initial resource reload.
